Title: Osney Bridge towpath diversion
Description: Towpath closed 150 yards before bridge. Diversion along Abbey Road.

Title: Marsh Lock footbridge closed Henley-Shiplake
Description: Marsh Lock footbridge closed May 2022 for safety. 2.7 mile diversion via A4155. Closure extended beyond 31 Jan 2026.

Title: Sandford Footbridge closure
Description: Unsafe footbridge north of Sandford Lock closed. Diversion via NCN 5.

Title: Abingdon Weir walkway intermittent closure
Description: Weir walkway closed due to high water levels and corrosion. Intermittent closure reopened 30 Sept 2025. Diverts via Abingdon town centre.

Title: Temple Footbridge closed Marlow-Hurley
Description: Temple Footbridge closed May 2023. Centre span removed Nov 2025. Unlikely to reopen until 2028. Diversion via Marlow Bridge.

Title: Bridge 142 closure near Runnymede M25
Description: Footbridge damaged Feb 2024 after tree strike. Diversion 0.6 mi via A308. Expected until 2027.

Title: Bell Weir Lock construction diversion
Description: Thames Path diverted at Runnymede Pleasure Ground due to Bell Weir refurbishment works. Small compound diversion. Work spring 2026 to autumn 2027.

Title: Penton Hook Island closure
Description: Penton Hook Island closed due to diseased trees (ash dieback). Path unaffected but island inaccessible. No reopening date.

Title: Ten Foot Bridge closure Faringdon
Description: Ten Foot Bridge between Rushey and Shifford Locks near Buckland closed March 2024 for structural safety concerns. No reopening date.

Title: Brentford Grand Union Canal disruption
Description: Path blocked on left bank of Grand Union Canal between River Brent bridge and Brentford Marina. Area being redeveloped. Partial reopening reported.

Title: Streatley-Goring towpath diversion
Description: Footpath south of Streatley/Goring closed for riverbank repairs. Diversion via Manor Road and Footpath 227. Riverside route unlikely to reopen until late 2026.
